verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: an XML API with a sandbox, a Go SDK with register, renew and lock calls, and a Terraform provider. It also mentions a Dynamic DNS endpoint that a user's own update client must call on a regular basis. None of this is a first-party feature for setting up automations that run on their own in the background. Under the partial-credit rules, primitives and user-run clients earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
